categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Boyuan Pharmaceutical & Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the fine chemicals sector, focusing on the research, production, and sales of iodides, specialty functional chemicals, and chemical trading. Their products serve pharmaceutical, chemical, optoelectronic materials, feed, and food industries. The company also engages in resource comprehensive utilization, integrating waste recycling into its business model.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs proprietary industrial production technologies for iodides and specialty functional chemicals, including patented processes for catalyst recovery and iodide recycling. Key technologies include continuous discharge of burned iodine water, rhodium recovery from waste liquids, and continuous production of potassium iodide. They emphasize green, safe, and efficient manufacturing with advanced catalytic materials and resource recycling techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in pharmaceutical manufacturing (notably contrast agents), optoelectronic materials (polarizing films), and chemical industries. The company serves markets related to medical imaging, display panels, emergency rescue, and environmental protection. Their products are widely used in medicine, agriculture, food additives, and feed sectors, with a strong domestic sales focus.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and production facilities in Shouguang City, Shandong Province. Domestic sales constitute over 97% of revenue, with limited export activities accounting for about 2.2%. The company’s market presence is primarily regional within China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Boyuan operates mainly in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, focusing on manufacturing fine chemical intermediates and specialty chemicals. It also integrates upstream resource recycling by procuring waste materials from customers and other enterprises for raw material extraction, enhancing circular economy practices.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and green development, investing heavily in R&D to improve production efficiency, product quality, and environmental safety. Key R&D projects include catalyst recovery, continuous production processes, and new product development in iodides and specialty chemicals. They maintain multiple patents and provincial-level technology centers, aiming to expand market share and enhance sustainable practices.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products including iodides and specialty functional chemicals. The company also earns income from chemical trading and processing services. Sales are mostly on a direct sales basis, with revenue recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Boyuan holds a leading market position in iodides and luminescent materials within its niche. It is recognized as a specialized and innovative enterprise with provincial and national honors. The company benefits from high entry barriers due to strict environmental and safety regulations, which limit competition from less compliant firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.33 billion, a 29.53% increase over the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 213 million, up 17.04%. Total assets nearly doubled to RMB 1.87 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and asset base, supported by increased R&D investment and successful IPO in December 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Boyuan differentiates itself through a combined product and resource recycling business model, offering integrated chemical products and waste resource utilization services. It emphasizes high product quality, stable supply, and compliance with stringent environmental and safety standards. The company’s proprietary technologies and patents enhance product purity, yield, and cost efficiency, providing customers with reliable, innovative, and sustainable chemical solutions.
